name: SurvivalMonsterType - Default (seed v1)
description: A vanilla monster type of a survival scenario's normal waves, with its draw weight and first round (DESIGN S42, S56).

steps.description: Enemies of a round are drawn by weight from the selected types that are unlocked in that round. Readiness needs at least one type unlocked in round 1.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The siege scenario this belongs to; filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Monster type
fields.description: A vanilla Minecraft monster type, e.g. ZOMBIE, SKELETON, SPIDER, CREEPER (stored upper case).

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Draw weight among the selected types (default 1, equal chances).

fields.label: First round
fields.description: The first round this type can appear in (default 1).

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Leave empty to add it after the existing types.
